text:
Type: perforated metal wall clock
Use: telling time on a wall; living room, home office, kitchen
Style: industrial, modern, minimalist
Materials: perforated steel face with a dotted pattern, matching perforated hands
Colors: medium grey, dark grey
Shape: flat round disc covered in small round holes, two wide flat hands in the same perforated metal, clean blank dial, graphic and light
Feel: graphic, cool, sleek, modern
Goes with: concrete, black metal, grey or white walls, dark wood; industrial, modern or minimalist rooms

product.name: SIPPRA
product.description: The steel mesh creates shadows and texture, giving the hands and clock face a feeling of dimension.
